inventory.title: 📦 Inventory
inventory.enrichMissingVivino: missing pairings or description, never checked against Vivino
inventory.enrichMissingAI: missing a drink window or verdict, never analyzed by AI
inventory.enrichRetryVivino: checked against Vivino, still nothing — Vivino does add bottles over time
inventory.enrichRetryAI: analyzed by AI, still without a verdict
inventory.enrichConfirmBodyOne: {count} wine will be looked up. This is a slow, rate-limited network call — expect it to run for a while, and leave the dialog open until it finishes.
inventory.enrichConfirmBodyMany: {count} wines will be looked up one at a time. This is a slow, rate-limited network call — expect it to run for a while, and leave the dialog open until it finishes.
inventory.retryExplain: These were already checked and came back empty. The check date is updated either way, so you can always see when the last attempt was.
inventory.newExplain: Some will come back with nothing new — not every bottle exists in {source}. Those move to the retry line below rather than staying here.
inventory.vivinoFillsExplain: Fills food pairings, description, rating and the label photo where Vivino has them. Existing values are kept.
inventory.aiFillsExplain: Fills the drinking verdict, drink window and critic scores where the AI can infer them. Existing values are kept.
inventory.heavyHistoryHint: Home Assistant rewrites this whole file on every change — clearing old history speeds up every edit.
inventory.enrichRetryNote: Their check date is updated — try again later.
inventory.enrichMoveToRetryNote: Their check date is updated; they move to the retry line.
inventory.backupSaved: Backup saved — {wines} wines, {cabinets} racks, {buyList} buy list
inventory.noWinesInCsv: No wines found in CSV file.
inventory.importSkippedNoteOne: {skipped} row kept its previous spot — the location given was unknown, out of range or already taken.
inventory.importSkippedNoteMany: {skipped} rows kept their previous spot — the location given was unknown, out of range or already taken.
inventory.invalidBackupWines: Invalid backup file: missing wines array.
inventory.invalidBackupCabinets: Invalid backup file: missing cabinets array.
inventory.restoredCount: Restored {wines} wines, {cabinets} racks, {buyList} buy list items!
inventory.keepNBackups: Keeping the {n} most recent server backups.
inventory.missingPairingsHintOne: {n} wine has no pairing data. Only Vivino supplies pairings — use “Fill from Vivino” below the list.
inventory.missingPairingsHintMany: {n} wines have no pairing data. Only Vivino supplies pairings — use “Fill from Vivino” below the list.
